_comment: Off-report items the günlük rapor holds but EXCLUDES from its totals (blank 'Rapora Gelsin', or a block outside the summaries). Sign convention: amountUsd > 0 = obligation (reduces the economic net), amountUsd < 0 = asset/receivable (raises it). An item may carry amountTl instead of amountUsd — financials.py and the dashboard convert it at the day's TCMB kur. Items with 'countedBy' are already inside financial_data.json and are NOT added again by financials.py (the dashboard still lists them). Maintained by hand / by Claude on Abdu's instruction — daily-brief's financials.py only READS this file.
